sentences.text:
Appearance:
 Shri Sanjay Sharma - Advocate for the applicant.
 Ms. Shikha Singh Baghel - Panel Lawyer for the respondent/S
 Order
This is first bail application filed on behalf of applicant under Section 483 of the Bharatiya Nagarik Suraksha Sanhita, 2023.

2 . The applicant is in jail since 25.06.2024 in connection with Crime No.293 of 2024 registered at P.S. Kotwali Balaghat District-Balaghat for the offence punishable under Sections 363, 344, 368,
376 and 376(2)(N) of the IPC, Sections 5, 6 and 21 of the POCSO Act and Sections 3(2)(v) and 3(1)(w)(ii) of SC/ST Act.
3 . Prosecution story in brief is that applicant repeatedly committed aggravated penetrative sexual assault on minor prosecutrix.
4. Learned counsel for the applicant submits on the date of incident, prosecutrix was aged 17 years 10 months.
It is also urged that prosecutrix went missing on 10.05.2024 and missing person report was lodged on 13.05.2024.
Prosecutrix has been recovered from applicant's house on 24.06.2024.
It is also urged that parties have solemnized the marriage in temple.
As of now, prosecutrix is residing with applicant's family.
Applicant is in jail since 25.06.2024.

After NEUTRAL CITATION NO.
2025:MPHC-JBP:25332 2 MCRC-19268-2025 investigation, charge-sheet has been filed.
No injuries have been found on the person of prosecutrix.

It is also urged that before trial Court,
prosecutrix has filed an affidavit that she has no objection, if applicant is released on bail.
On above grounds, it is urged that applicant be released on bail.

sentences.text: 5. Learned Panel Lawyer for the respondent/State, on the other hand, has opposed the application.
6. Looking to overall facts and circumstances of the case, I deem it proper to release the applicant on bail.

7 . It is directed that applicant be released on bail on his furnishing a personal bond in the sum of Rs.15,000/- (Rupees Fifteen Thousand only) with one solvent surety in the like amount to the satisfaction of the trial Court, for his regular appearance before the trial Court during trial with a condition that he shall remain present before the concerned Court on all the dates fixed by it during trial.
He shall abide by all the conditions enumerated under Section 480(3) of Bharatiya Nagarik Suraksha Sanhita, 2023.
8. This order shall be effective till the end of the trial.
However, in case of bail jump and breach of any of the conditions of bail, it shall become ineffective.
9. Soft copy of this bail order be sent immediately/forthwith to the applicant through concerned Jail Superintendent.
10. M.Cr.C. stands allowed and disposed of.
11. Certified copy as per rules.
